# U.S. Dictionary

> > A comprehensive English language reference providing word definitions, idioms, and vocabulary with examples, synonyms, and etymologies for American English speakers.

U.S. Dictionary is a language reference resource founded by Shaun Connell and Ariana Kumpf that specializes in definitions, idioms, and vocabulary for US English. The site covers everything from common words to specialized terms, internet slang, and cultural expressions with detailed examples and pronunciation guides.

## Key Topics

- Word definitions
- Idioms and phrases
- US English vocabulary
- Etymology
- Synonyms and antonyms
- Pronunciation guides
- Definition examples
- English language reference
- Phrase meanings
- Internet slang
- Cultural expressions
- Vocabulary learning

## Core Reference

- [U.S. Dictionary: Meaning and Definitions of Words and Idioms](https://usdictionary.com): Homepage with comprehensive word definitions and idioms
- [Definitions - US Dictionary](https://usdictionary.com/definitions): Main definitions reference page with vocabulary word list and meanings
- [Idioms - US Dictionary](https://usdictionary.com/idioms): Idioms reference hub with phrases and US English expressions

## Word Definitions

- [Cuddle: Definition, Meaning, and Examples](https://usdictionary.com/definitions/cuddle): Definition and examples of 'cuddle' with synonyms and antonyms
- [Cluster: Definition, Meaning, and Examples](https://usdictionary.com/definitions/cluster): Definition and pronunciation guide for 'cluster' with usage examples
- [Modulus: Definition, Meaning, and Examples](https://usdictionary.com/definitions/modulus): Mathematical term 'modulus' with Young's modulus and engineering applications
- [Zeitgeist: Definition, Meaning, and Examples](https://usdictionary.com/definitions/zeitgeist): German-origin word 'zeitgeist' with etymology and cultural context
- [Demo: Definition, Meaning, and Examples](https://usdictionary.com/definitions/demo): Definition of 'demo' covering trials, samples, and pronunciation
- [Bundle: Definition, Meaning, and Examples](https://usdictionary.com/definitions/bundle): Definition of 'bundle' tracing evolution from package to marketing tactic
- [Golden Plateau: Definition, Meaning, and Examples](https://usdictionary.com/definitions/golden-plateau): AI and economics term 'golden plateau' definition with etymology
- [Pro-life: Definition, Meaning, and Examples](https://usdictionary.com/definitions/pro-life): Definition of 'pro-life' exploring political stance and bioethics

## Idioms and Phrases

- [Rub Shoulders: Definition, Meaning, and Origin](https://usdictionary.com/idioms/rub-shoulders): Idiom definition exploring 'rub shoulders' networking phrase origin
- [Rickroll: Definition, Meaning, and Origin](https://usdictionary.com/idioms/rickroll): Internet meme 'rickroll' definition from Rick Astley and 4chan origin
- [Rile Me Up: Definition, Meaning, and Origin](https://usdictionary.com/idioms/rile-me-up): Idiom definition of 'rile me up' expressing emotional disturbance
- [Don't Get Me Wrong: Definition, Meaning, and Origin](https://usdictionary.com/idioms/dont-get-me-wrong): Idiom definition of 'don't get me wrong' as communication disclaimer
- [In the Loop: Definition, Meaning, and Origin](https://usdictionary.com/idioms/in-the-loop): Business idiom 'in the loop' for communication and workplace teamwork
- [Piece of Heaven: Definition, Meaning, and Origin](https://usdictionary.com/idioms/piece-of-heaven): Idiom 'piece of heaven' capturing bliss and paradise concept
